question.text: For two types of magnetic materials $A$ and $B$, variation of $\frac{1}{\chi}$ ( $\chi:$ susceptibility) vs. temperature $T$ is shown in the figure. Then

options.text: A is paramagnetic and B is ferromagnetic

solution.text: Graph will be a straight line having +ve slope for ferromagnetic material and of 0 slope for diamagnetic material.  2)also change spelling of ferromagnetic in question from 'feromagnetic' to 'ferromagnetic' .
